description: Return a complete, self-contained HTML page that embeds the AR studio, configured for the caller's models. Write it to a file, commit it, and it works on GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, or any static host: no build step and no API key. Use it when someone asks to "add AR to my site" rather than just to see a model.

assets.description: Catalogue URL for the model tray. Defaults to the free CC0 library.

generate.description: Show the text-to-3D prompt box. Default true.

models.description: Models pre-loaded into the scene on open.

x.description: Metres right of the viewer. Default 0.

yaw.description: Rotation in radians about the vertical axis.

z.description: Metres in front of the viewer, negative is further away. Default -1.6.

name: create_ar_page
title: Generate a deployable AR page
